messages:
Hannah (CS): Quick swarm — NovaShop POC: reserved GPU pool provisioning failing in us-central1, demo in 6 hours. Customer blocked.
Liam (Sales): They're asking if we can shift region for demo and if that changes committed pricing. Also need static egress for their firewall.
Rajat (Platform Eng): Paste the provisioner error please.
Hannah (CS): Error from UI:
```
ERROR: AllocationFailed: NoAvailableIPs: subnet 10.10.16.0/24 has 0 usable addresses
CausedBy: QuotaExceeded: GPU quota (v100) = 0 for project=novashop-prod in us-central1
RequestID: prov-2a9c
```
Hannah (CS): Customer infra carved a single /24 for pods and didn't request GPU quota.
Maya (Infra): Two parallel fixes: (1) expand subnet or add secondary range for alias IPs; (2) request GPU quota increase. Fastest demo path may be managed tenancy in us-central1 if provider capacity exists.
Tess (Security): If we use managed tenancy, we need CMK access or customer must provide a key in that region. Also require an audit-log endpoint and DPA signoff for managed tenancy.
Rajat (Platform Eng): Workarounds ranked: A) transient managed pool in same region (if available) — ~30-60m; B) provision in us-east1 and route traffic — need latency ok and KMS check; C) customer expands subnet + quota ticket — slower.
provisioner-bot: Provision attempt #4 failed at 08:42 UTC: insufficient_ips (prov-2a9c). Logs: https://ci.internal/prov/2a9c
Liam (Sales): Customer said they'd accept us-east for demo if we guarantee static egress IPs and CMK access. They prefer staying in US.
Maya (Infra): We can provide static NAT IPs from managed tenancy and advise on CMK policy snippet. Will check availability now (ETA 20m).
Tess (Security): I'll prepare minimal CMK grant and a short checklist for managed tenancy.
Rajat (Platform Eng): Action items:
- (Maya) check managed tenancy capacity and provide NAT IP list if allocated (ETA 20m)
- (Hannah) send GPU quota template and subnet expansion steps to customer (ETA 10m)
- (Tess) draft CMK grant template and DPA checklist (ETA 40m)
- (Liam) confirm customer acceptance of transient billing and note for finance (ETA 30m)
Hannah (CS): Customer agreed to transient managed pool for demo if NAT IPs and CMK access provided. I'll coordinate and report back.
Liam (Sales): Thanks team — please flag anything that would delay the demo window or impact pricing commitments.
Hannah (CS): Closing loop: last status 09:15 UTC — managed tenancy allocation in progress; customer to test at 09:45 UTC.
